items.zh: 这杯冰美式能帮我换成外带杯吗？
items.scene: 咖啡店柜台，顾客刚接过堂食杯

answers.en: Could you put this iced Americano in a to-go cup?
answers.note: 礼貌而直接的柜台请求，明确要求换成外带杯；比 Can I get 的说法更客气，适合店员正在忙时。

answers.en: Can I get this iced Americano to go instead?
answers.note: 口语点单说法，instead 表示临时改主意；比 Could you 的请求更随意，适合快节奏柜台或熟客。

answers.en: Would you mind putting this in a to-go cup?
answers.note: 最客气，would you mind 把请求放软；适合店员正忙或你不想显得催促，日常柜台用会稍正式。

items.zh: 大杯燕麦拿铁比普通拿铁贵多少？
items.scene: 咖啡店柜台，顾客盯着菜单比价格

answers.en: How much more is a large oat milk latte than a regular one?
answers.note: 直接问两种饮品的差价，信息最完整；适合想精确比较杯型和奶的选择时。

answers.en: What's the upcharge for a large oat milk latte?
answers.note: 用 upcharge 问加价，简洁像常客；适合店员忙、你只想知道要多付多少钱。

answers.en: Is the large oat milk latte a lot more than the regular?
answers.note: 是非问句，只关心贵不贵得多，不要求具体金额；语气随口，适合先听个大概。

items.zh: 我想坐一下午，你们这儿有插座吗？
items.scene: 周末下午，顾客抱着电脑走进咖啡店

answers.en: Do you have outlets here? I'm planning to stay for the afternoon.
answers.note: 先问插座再说明要久坐，礼貌清楚；适合第一次进店、不确定能否坐一下午。

answers.en: Are there any outlets I can use? I'll be here a while.
answers.note: 把重点放在能不能用，比只问有没有插座更直接；适合已经买好饮品再开口。

answers.en: Got any outlets? I want to camp out here all afternoon.
answers.note: Got any 很口语，camp out 带玩笑感；适合气氛轻松、对方像同龄店员时。

items.zh: 这杯奶茶能做三分糖吗？
items.scene: 奶茶店点单，顾客想少甜但保留一点甜味

answers.en: Could you make this milk tea with less sugar?
answers.note: 笼统请求减糖，最稳妥；店员会按常规少糖比例做，不保证精确到三分。

answers.en: Can I get it at thirty percent sugar?
answers.note: 指定三成糖，适合菜单有甜度档位的店；数字明确，点单效率高。

answers.en: Go light on the sugar, please.
answers.note: 口语短句，只表达少放糖；语气随和，适合熟店或不想研究甜度档位时。

items.zh: 少糖是不是就一点也不甜了？
items.scene: 奶茶店柜台，顾客犹豫要不要选少糖

answers.en: Does less sugar mean it won't be sweet at all?
answers.note: 直接确认少糖是否等于完全不甜；适合第一次点、担心味道寡淡的人。

answers.en: If I cut the sugar, will it still taste sweet?
answers.note: 用 if 设想结果，语气犹豫；像请店员帮你判断，而不是质疑菜单。

answers.en: Is the low-sugar version completely unsweet?
answers.note: 把少糖当成产品版本，措辞偏正式；适合认真确认配方，不像随口一问。

items.zh: 我最近戒糖，有不加糖的喝法吗？
items.scene: 咖啡店，朋友让顾客先选饮品

answers.en: I'm off sugar right now — is there anything you can make without it?
answers.note: I'm off sugar 是口语说法，带解释意味；问法委婉，适合朋友或店员帮你搭配。

answers.en: I've cut sugar out. What can I get that has none?
answers.note: 陈述更干脆，后半句直接要无糖选项；适合已经决定、不想被推荐甜饮。

answers.en: I'm trying to avoid sugar. Do you have any drinks with no added sugar?
answers.note: 最明确，特别区分无添加糖；适合需要确认配料，而不只是问口味时。

items.zh: 去冰的话，这杯会不会只有半杯？
items.scene: 奶茶店点单，顾客盯着去冰选项

answers.en: If I get it with no ice, will the cup only be half full?
answers.note: 直接问容量会不会缩水，画面具体；适合担心少冰就少饮料的顾客。

answers.en: Without ice, do you still fill the cup all the way?
answers.note: 改问是否加满，重点在店家的做法；比问半杯少一点抱怨感。

answers.en: Will I get less drink if I ask for no ice?
answers.note: 最概括，只问会不会少给；语气平和，适合不想把问题说得太具体时。

items.zh: 能不能少放点冰，但别完全去冰？
items.scene: 夏天奶茶店点单，顾客想要微凉口感

answers.en: Could you use a little less ice, but not take it all out?
answers.note: 完整说明少冰但不去冰，最不容易误解；适合第一次点或店员较忙。

answers.en: Can I get light ice?
answers.note: light ice 是饮品店常用说法，简短高效；适合菜单上有少冰选项的连锁店。

answers.en: Could you go easy on the ice? I still want it cold.
answers.note: go easy on 很口语，补一句仍要冰的；能避免店员直接做成常温。

items.zh: 美式可以免费续杯吗？
items.scene: 快餐店早餐时段，顾客端着空咖啡杯

answers.en: Are coffee refills free here?
answers.note: 把续杯当成店内规则来问，标准清楚；适合第一次来、想确认政策。

answers.en: Can I get a free refill on this?
answers.note: 直接要求免费续杯，语气随意；适合已看到别人续杯或店员好说话时。

answers.en: Is it okay if I get this refilled for free?
answers.note: Is it okay if 让请求更婉转，礼貌度高；适合不想被当成占便宜时。

items.zh: 续杯是只能续一样的，还是能换别的？
items.scene: 快餐店饮料区，顾客想换个口味

answers.en: Can I only refill with the same drink, or can I switch to something else?
answers.note: 完整二选一，规则问得最清楚；适合店员不忙、你想一次确认。

answers.en: Does the refill have to be the same, or can I get a different drink?
answers.note: 用 have to 问限制，语气中性；更像在确认规定，而不是请求通融。

answers.en: Am I stuck with the same coffee for a refill?
answers.note: stuck with 带抱怨和玩笑色彩；适合朋友间或熟店，正式场合不合适。

items.zh: 这家奶茶排队要半小时，值得等吗？
items.scene: 商场奶茶店门口，朋友看着长队犹豫

answers.en: This place has a half-hour line — is it worth the wait?
answers.note: 先陈述排队时间再问值不值，语气客观；适合两人都还没决定时。

answers.en: Is this milk tea really worth waiting thirty minutes for?
answers.note: 把怀疑放在 really 上，更像反问；适合你已经不太想等、想劝朋友走。

answers.en: Do you think it's worth standing in line that long?
answers.note: 问对方判断，语气最中性；适合把决定权交给同伴，不暴露自己的倾向。

items.zh: 你喝过他们家的芋泥波波吗？好喝吗？
items.scene: 奶茶店菜单前，顾客向常来的朋友打听

answers.en: Have you tried their taro milk tea with boba? Is it good?
answers.note: 先确认喝没喝过再问评价，节奏自然；适合朋友间边看菜单边聊。

answers.en: How's their taro boba? Have you had it?
answers.note: 先问味道再补问经历，重点在评价；适合对方没喝过也能给看法时。

answers.en: Is their taro boba any good? I can't decide.
answers.note: any good 带一点怀疑，补一句拿不定主意；像请朋友帮你拍板。

items.zh: 你觉得我该点热的还是冰的？
items.scene: 奶茶店点单，顾客拿不定主意问朋友

answers.en: Do you think I should get it hot or iced?
answers.note: 标准征求意见，两个选项都摆出来；语气平和，适合朋友帮你选。

answers.en: Hot or iced — which one should I go with?
answers.note: 先抛选项再问决定，节奏口语化；适合关系熟、点单时间紧时。

answers.en: What would you get, hot or iced?
answers.note: 改问对方会选什么，把建议变成代入式选择；语气更轻松，不显得依赖。

items.zh: 下午三点要不要一起点个下午茶？
items.scene: 办公室工位间，同事下午有点犯困

answers.en: Want to order some afternoon snacks around three?
answers.note: 直接问要不要点零食，afternoon snacks 在办公室很常用；适合普通同事。

answers.en: Should we do a coffee run at three?
answers.note: coffee run 特指出去买咖啡，不一定有吃的；适合大家想喝咖啡提神时。

answers.en: How about we get something delivered for an afternoon pick-me-up?
answers.note: pick-me-up 指提神的东西，强调外卖和恢复精力；适合工作累、想点甜点饮料时。

items.zh: 客户三点来，会议室要不要备点茶和点心？
items.scene: 行政人员准备下午的客户会议

answers.en: The client's coming at three — should we set out tea and snacks in the meeting room?
answers.note: 先陈述安排再提议，set out 指摆好；语气务实，适合和同事确认准备。

answers.en: Should we have tea and pastries ready in the conference room for the three o'clock client?
answers.note: 更正式完整，pastries 显得招待规格更高；适合向上级确认待客安排。

answers.en: Do you want me to put out some tea and cookies before the client arrives?
answers.note: 主动请缨做事，cookies 比 pastries 随意；适合平级同事之间分工。

items.zh: 我快饿死了，你抽屉里还有零食吗？
items.scene: 加班下午，同事从隔板后探头

answers.en: Do you still have snacks in your desk? I'm starving.
answers.note: 直接问还有没有零食，starving 夸张但日常；适合关系普通的同事。

answers.en: Got any snacks left in your drawer? I'm starving here.
answers.note: Got any 更口语，drawer 明确指抽屉；适合熟同事之间随口问。

answers.en: Any chance you have snacks in your desk? I'm really hungry.
answers.note: Any chance 让请求更委婉；适合不太熟、怕打扰对方时，带试探感。

items.zh: 这包薯片开了多久了？还能吃吗？
items.scene: 客厅茶几旁，家人拿起敞口的薯片

answers.en: How long has this bag of chips been open? Is it still good?
answers.note: 先问放了多久再问能不能吃，逻辑清楚；适合家人之间正常确认。

answers.en: When did you open these chips? Are they still okay?
answers.note: 用 when did you 问具体时间，更像追查；语气直接，适合熟人之间。

answers.en: Are these chips still any good? They've been open a while.
answers.note: 先问是否还能吃，再说已放一阵，带嫌弃感；适合熟人吐槽，不适合客套。

items.zh: 晚上看电影，要不要买点爆米花和可乐？
items.scene: 电影院门口，两人准备检票

answers.en: Want to grab popcorn and a soda for the movie?
answers.note: grab 很口语，soda 是美国常用说法；适合朋友间快速提议。

answers.en: Should we get popcorn and soda before the movie?
answers.note: 用 should we 征求意见，语气更协商；适合还没决定要不要买时。

answers.en: How about popcorn and a Coke for the movie tonight?
answers.note: How about 最轻松，Coke 具体到可乐品牌；适合两人已站在卖品部前。

items.zh: 我在减肥，这杯全糖奶茶得跑多久才能消耗掉？
items.scene: 健身房更衣室，朋友递来一杯奶茶

answers.en: I'm trying to lose weight — how long would I have to run to burn off this full-sugar milk tea?
answers.note: 完整说明在减肥再问运动量，语气认真；适合真的想估算热量。

answers.en: How much running would it take to work off a full-sugar milk tea? I'm on a diet.
answers.note: 先问要跑多少再补在节食，重点在运动量；语气略带无奈。

answers.en: If I drink this sugary milk tea, how long do I need to run to burn it off? I'm watching my weight.
answers.note: 用 if 假设喝完再问，带自我调侃；适合朋友递饮料、你半推半就时。

items.zh: 晚上不吃晚饭，只吃一包饼干能减肥吗？
items.scene: 午休茶水间，同事聊起减肥办法

answers.en: Will skipping dinner and just eating a pack of cookies help me lose weight?
answers.note: 直接问这种吃法有没有用，语气中性；适合认真讨论减肥计划。

answers.en: Can I lose weight by having nothing but a pack of cookies for dinner?
answers.note: 强调只吃饼干，带怀疑；像在确认这个办法是否靠谱。

answers.en: Is trading dinner for a package of cookies going to help me slim down?
answers.note: trading dinner for 有调侃感，slim down 较口语；适合熟人之间自嘲。

items.zh: 奶茶换成无糖茶，热量会差很多吗？
items.scene: 奶茶店柜台，顾客在菜单上比较饮品

answers.en: If I switch from milk tea to unsweetened tea, is there a big difference in calories?
answers.note: 完整问替换后的热量差；适合认真比较，想知道差距大不大。

answers.en: How many fewer calories does unsweetened tea have compared with milk tea?
answers.note: 直接问少多少卡，要求具体数字；语气更像在算账。

answers.en: Would unsweetened tea save me a lot of calories over milk tea?
answers.note: 用 save calories 问能省多少，口语感强；适合朋友间聊减肥。

items.zh: 这家奶茶店排队排到门外了，还要等吗？
items.scene: 商场里，两人看到奶茶店门口的长队

answers.en: The line for this milk tea place is out the door — do you still want to wait?
answers.note: 先陈述队伍排到门外再问，画面清楚；适合两人刚看到队伍时。

answers.en: There's a line around the block for this place. Are we waiting?
answers.note: around the block 夸张强调人多，Are we waiting 很简短；带不耐烦。

answers.en: Do you really want to stand in this line? It's out the door.
answers.note: 把 really 放前面表示怀疑，像在劝对方放弃；比中性询问更不耐。

items.zh: 自助点单是不是就不用排队了？
items.scene: 奶茶店门口，顾客看到自助点单机

answers.en: If I order at the kiosk, do I skip the line?
answers.note: kiosk 指自助点单机，问是否能跳过排队；简洁直接，适合第一次用。

answers.en: Does ordering on the self-service screen mean I don't have to wait in line?
answers.note: 把屏幕点单和免排队的关系说全，语气谨慎；适合怕排错队时。

answers.en: Can I just use the kiosk and avoid the line?
answers.note: just 带“是不是这样就行”的轻松感；适合已打算用机器、只想确认。

items.zh: 第一次喝这家，你推荐哪个不容易踩雷？
items.scene: 奶茶店菜单前，朋友是这家常客

answers.en: It's my first time here — what do you recommend that won't disappoint?
answers.note: 先说明第一次来再请推荐，won't disappoint 表达怕踩雷；语气自然。

answers.en: What's a safe bet for a first-timer here?
answers.note: safe bet 指稳妥选择，非常口语；适合朋友间快速给建议。

answers.en: What should I get here? I don't want to end up with something I hate.
answers.note: 直接说不想到手难喝，情绪直白；适合关系熟、说话不用客气时。

items.zh: 有没有不太甜、咖啡味又浓一点的推荐？
items.scene: 咖啡店柜台，顾客看着满墙菜单

answers.en: Do you have anything that isn't too sweet but has a strong coffee flavor?
answers.note: 完整说出两个条件，清楚但略长；适合店员有空、你想一次问明白。

answers.en: What would you recommend that's not too sweet and actually tastes like coffee?
answers.note: 请店员推荐，actually tastes like coffee 带吐槽；语气更活，适合熟店。

answers.en: I'd like something not too sweet with a stronger coffee taste — any suggestions?
answers.note: 先说自己想要什么再要建议，礼貌度更高；适合连锁店正式柜台。
